title: A Decision Matrix for Optimal Matching of Biological Systems to Microgravity Simulation Platforms

contributions.purpose: 定义微重力模拟器生物保真度的量化指标
contributions.mechanism: 对 NASA GeneLab 空间组学数据做 meta 分析,用 Jaccard + Spearman 构建 Biological Fidelity Score(BFS,0-1)
contributions.evaluation: 声称 BFS 跨系统剧烈波动:心脏祖细胞 clinostat 0.85,C.elegans vs Drosophila 仅 6 基因重叠 BFS<0.01(数据来源存疑,见 notes)
contributions.domain: 空间生物学/微重力模拟
contributions.source_quote: we formulated a composite Biological Fidelity Score (BFS) from 0 (no correlation) to 1 (perfect identity), calculated using the Jaccard similarity index and Spearman correlation for transcriptomic data

contributions.purpose: 提供预测模拟器保真度的决策矩阵
contributions.mechanism: Random Forest 回归(scikit-learn)以 mechanosensitivity/复杂度等生物参数预测 BFS,80/20 划分
contributions.evaluation: 决策矩阵(Table 1)按 BFS<0.6 阈值给推荐;但训练数据为 np.random 造的 mock data,R²/F1 从未在正文报告实际值
contributions.source_quote: The primary contribution of this work is the development and validation of the first data-driven decision matrix that quantitatively predicts the fidelity of ground-based simulators based on the intrinsic characteristics of a biological system.

notes: 严重数据红旗。正文 Methods 详述 prospective 湿实验(人成骨细胞 OCY454、Jurkat T、hiPSC 心脏类器官,RPM/RWV,24/72/168h,n=4,RNA-seq),给出具体 BFS(0.45/0.65/0.85 等)与决策矩阵表——但附录 A 代码用 np.random 造数:np.random.rand(250) 生成 Biological_Fidelity_Score,np.random.choice 造所有特征,注释 'Using a mock data generator for demonstration'。checklist AI 局限自曝:'AI cannot access or generate real, novel experimental data; it relied on synthesizing existing literature and generating mock data for code demonstration'。即所谓前瞻性多组学验证从未开展,结果表与模型均建立在合成随机数据上=fabricated experiments + np.random 造数。checklist 高 AI 参与(实验设计/分析=A AI-generated,假设/写作=B)。非实证类适配:决策矩阵无真实数据支撑,纯占位演示。与 reject 一致。
